require('App/Manager/UIManager/EUILayers')

require('App/UI/BasePanel')
require('App/UI/BossPanel/BossPanel')
require('App/UI/BuiltPanel')
require('App/UI/BossGamePanel')
require('App/UI/CountDownPanel')
require('App/UI/MenuPanel')
require('App/UI/BossGameWinPanel')
require('App/UI/BossGameLosePanel')

UIManager = Object:SubClass('UIManager')

UIManager.panelDic = {}

function UIManager:ShowPanel(panelName, layerType, callBack)
    local panel
    local layer
    if layerType == EUILayers.Bottom then
        layer = GameManager.cs.uiManager.Bottom
    elseif layerType == EUILayers.Middle then
        layer = GameManager.cs.uiManager.Middle
    elseif layerType == EUILayers.Top then
        layer = GameManager.cs.uiManager.Top
    elseif layerType == EUILayers.System then
        layer = GameManager.cs.uiManager.System
    else
        layer = GameManager.cs.uiManager.Bottom
    end

    -- 加载面板预设体
    if self.panelDic[panelName] == nil then
        local prefabs = GameManager.addressablesManager:GetAsset(typeof(GameObject), panelName, 'UI')
        
        if prefabs == nil then
            prefabs = Resources.Load('UI/' .. panelName)
        end

        if prefabs == nil then
            print('UI prefabs is nil')
            return
        end

        local panelObj = Instantiate(prefabs, layer)
        -- 设置
        panelObj.transform.localScale = Vector3.one
        -- 绑定到lua脚本
        panel = _G[panelName]
        panel.panelObj = panelObj
        -- 保存到字典
        self.panelDic[panelName] = panel
        -- 调用Show方法
        panel:Show()

        if callBack ~= nil then
            callBack(panel)
        end
    else
        if callBack ~= nil then
            callBack(self.panelDic[panelName])
        end
    end
end

function UIManager:HidePanel(panelName)
    -- 删除面板
    if self.panelDic[panelName] ~= nil then
        local panel = self.panelDic[panelName]
        panel:Hide()
        GameObject.Destroy(panel.panelObj)

        self.panelDic[panelName] = nil
    end
end

function UIManager:GetPanel(panelName)
    return self.panelDic[panelName]
end
